purpose: Deny that one action or fact amounts to another.
keywords: Plain clause + ことにはならない
An apology alone does not amount to taking responsibility.
Collecting materials does not mean you have understood them.
Remaining silent does not constitute agreement.
formation: Plain clause + ことにはならない
restrictions: Rejects equivalence or a claimed consequence.
mistake: This is different from a decision expressed with ことになる.
